name: ModelVariant683_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant683_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a stream of blinking orbs spirals in towards the other model's position, then a pale screen flash and a burst fly back to the active model: a striped dome inside a shaded ring, a flash square and 32 rays fanning out); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs six texture images and seeds the orbs, burst and delay from the command row indexed by the request; every call then counts down the delay and runs one frame, returning 1 once when the burst launches at frame 307, 2 once every orb and burst is inactive after that and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-700 and 767 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
